notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content: The game is now ported to a newer engine version (Godot 3.5.3) with the result of a better overall performance.

notes.title: Mod support is coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41846536/9b6e55411756afa06a0615b866d0eafcf82a6104.gif

I want to announce my attempt to implement a mod-support for Roma Invicta. I won't be able to do that for the campaign, but at least for the custom battles. The following is planned...


 soldiers will be customizable by looks and stats (you can even create new types of soldiers)
 adding pike-formations so you can implement for example greek phalanx etc.
 adding early firearms
 steam workshop implementation


here is a preview...
